note: NOT OFFICIAL. The sample questions and practice projects were written for this repo from common NZ tech interview patterns; no NZ agency publishes technical question lists. The links are the official or job-board sources: careers.govt.nz, Tahatū and Immigration NZ are government sites; SEEK and Trade Me are job boards.

nz: Tell me about yourself. (Keep it to 2 minutes: current role, one big result, why NZ, why this team.)
Why New Zealand, and why this company? What do you know about our product and customers?
Tell me about a time you disagreed with a manager or senior engineer. What did you do, and what happened? (STAR)
Tell me about a time something you shipped broke in production. How did you handle it and what changed after?
Describe a time you helped a teammate who was struggling. (Kiwi teams value humble, collaborative people.)
How do you work with people from different cultures or time zones? (Your Korea, Nepal and multilingual app experience fits here.)
What is your visa situation and when could you start? (Be clear: AEWV needed, relocating at own cost, notice period.)
How do you handle feedback? Give an example where feedback changed your approach.
mobile: Walk me through the architecture of an app you own. Why VIPER or MVVM, and what would you change?
How do you manage state in SwiftUI? When do you use @State, @StateObject, @ObservedObject or @Observable?
How would you find and fix a memory leak or retain cycle in an iOS app?
Explain async/await and actors in Swift. How do you avoid data races on the main thread?
How do you design offline-first behaviour and sync for a mobile app with a flaky network?
How does your release pipeline work? (signing, CI, TestFlight, phased rollout, crash monitoring)
How do you secure tokens and sensitive data on device? (Keychain, SSL pinning, jailbreak detection)
Flutter vs native: when would you choose each, and what are the trade-offs you have seen?
server: Design a REST API for transferring money between two accounts. How do you make it idempotent?
How do you handle a database transaction that spans two services? (outbox, saga, compensation)
In .NET, explain dependency injection lifetimes: singleton, scoped and transient. When does scoped go wrong?
async/await in C#: what is a deadlock with .Result, and how do you avoid it?
How would you find a slow endpoint in production? Walk through logs, metrics and tracing.
SQL: what indexes would you add for a query filtering by customer and date range, sorted by date?
How do you version an API without breaking existing mobile app clients?
Queues vs direct calls (SQS, Service Bus, Kafka): when do you use each?
uiux: Walk me through a project in your portfolio: the problem, your research, options you rejected, and the outcome.
How do you decide what to test with users, and how many users is enough?
How do you design for accessibility? (contrast, Dynamic Type, screen readers, WCAG 2.2)
How do you hand off designs to developers and handle changes once build has started?
Tell me about a time data or research proved your design wrong.
How would you simplify an identity-verification (KYC) flow without failing compliance?
How do you build and maintain a design system across web and mobile?
product: How do you decide what goes into the next quarter? Walk through your prioritisation method with a real example.
Tell me about a feature you killed or descoped. How did you tell stakeholders?
Which metrics would you track for a money-transfer app, and which one is the north star?
How do you work with engineering when an estimate is far bigger than expected?
Write a one-line problem statement for a feature you shipped, then tell me how you validated it.
How do you balance regulatory requirements (AML, KYC, privacy) against conversion?
How do you run discovery with customers you cannot easily meet (other countries, other languages)?
fintech: What happens end to end when a customer sends money overseas? (quote, FX, compliance screening, payout, reconciliation)
Why should money never be stored as a floating-point number? How do you handle currency rounding?
What are AML and KYC, and what do NZ's AML/CFT Act and the Privacy Act 2020 mean for an app like ours?
How do you make a payment request safe to retry? (idempotency keys, exactly-once effects)
How would you detect suspicious or fraudulent transactions without blocking good customers?
How do you test payment flows without moving real money? (sandboxes, test cards, contract tests)
What is reconciliation and what do you do when the ledger and the bank statement do not match?
ask_them: Is the company on the INZ accredited employer list, and will you support an AEWV application for this role?
Does the salary meet the AEWV median wage and, if relevant, the Green List threshold for Software Engineer?
What does the first 90 days look like, and how is success measured?
How does the team release: how often, who is on call, and how are incidents reviewed?
What is the hybrid or office policy, and is there any relocation support?
What is the biggest challenge the team faces this year?
